info.name: HustleHub+ Secure API
info.description: Part 2 test suite: authentication, gig management, bookings, transactions, RBAC, input sanitisation, security headers and rate limiting. Run with Newman using --insecure (self-signed certificate).

exec: pm.test('Submitted values are not echoed back', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('weak'));
pm.test('Rate limiting headers present on auth endpoint', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('RateLimit-Policy')).to.be.true);
pm.test('Generic error message (no user enumeration)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid credentials.'));
